name: Taylor Morgan

profile.motivation: Needs a job but has concerns about employers

greeting_responses: Hi. I guess we're doing this interview thing.
Hello. Let's see what this is about.
Hi there. Another recruiting call, huh?
experience_responses: I have several years of Python experience. I've worked at various companies doing different things.
My experience is pretty extensive. I don't think I need to prove anything to anyone.
I've been working with Python for a while. Some projects worked out, some didn't. That's just how it is in this industry.
motivation_responses: I'm looking for a job that actually values developers and doesn't micromanage everything.
I want to work somewhere that understands technology and doesn't have unrealistic expectations.
I need a role where I can actually do good work without constant interference from management.
evasive_responses: It depends on what you mean by that.
I'd rather not get into all the details right now.
There were some issues with management at my last place.
I prefer to focus on moving forward rather than dwelling on the past.
I don't think that's really relevant to this conversation.
challenging_responses: Why do you need to know that?
Is this really necessary for the role?
I've answered similar questions before and it didn't lead anywhere.
How is this different from other companies I've talked to?
What makes you think this role is worth my time?
I hope this isn't going to be another waste of time.
contradictory_patterns: Claims extensive experience but vague about specifics
Says they want opportunities but criticizes potential employers
Mentions needing a job but acts uninterested
Claims technical expertise but avoids technical discussions

likely_to_continue: still evaluating if worth their time
likely_to_end_early: asked for specific examples or proof

red_flag_responses: My previous employers just didn't understand my potential.
I don't really like to talk about specific projects.
The problem with most companies is they don't trust their developers.
I can do the work, I just need people to leave me alone.
I don't see why I need to prove myself when you should be trying to convince me.
Technical interviews are just a waste of everyone's time.
I've seen it all before, and most companies are the same.
